oci_acceptance.target: OCI 回读密文 SHA 与 R2 完全相同；未验证 R2 时 OCI 队列不前进。

blocking_oracle.verified_r2_queue_gate: RuntimeStore selects OCI candidates only when an R2 object_replica exists with status=verified. Without that receipt there is no OCI candidate.
blocking_oracle.same_cipher_gate: Before any OCI remote call, replicate_objects.py reads the R2 receipt and requires status=verified plus exact equality of original SHA-256, cipher SHA-256, and age encryption algorithm with the current EncryptedObject.
blocking_oracle.readback_boundary: Only after the three fields match can S3ReplicaStore upload the existing .age ciphertext and verify the full OCI readback against that same cipher SHA. A verified OCI receipt records that exact cipher SHA, original SHA, and algorithm.
blocking_oracle.mismatch_fail_closed: Missing, unverified, or mismatched R2 receipt records a failed OCI receipt with a bounded error code and returns before put_encrypted or download_verified is called.

fixture_coverage.unverified_r2: A captured artifact has no OCI queue candidate until the R2 receipt becomes verified.
fixture_coverage.mismatched_cipher: A verified R2 receipt with a different cipher SHA yields R2_CIPHER_SHA_MISMATCH; the fake OCI put_encrypted method would raise if reached and is not reached.
fixture_coverage.matching_cipher: A matching verified R2 receipt permits one fake OCI ciphertext upload, requires OCI readback to receive the same cipher SHA, and persists a verified OCI receipt with that SHA.
fixture_coverage.frozen_cli_and_runtime_guard: The exact frozen --once spelling is accepted. With all environment values stripped and no age recipient, it exits 3 with BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT before creating the configured data root.

semantic_reconciliation.reason: The frozen replica script needed a minimal compatibility adapter for its --once command. The current upstream queue status gate was retained and made fail-closed at dispatch by comparing all three R2 receipt fields before OCI provider work; no transaction/recovery-core rewrite or later-stage GitHub behavior was introduced.

execution_corrections: The SA-502 Task Graph invokes scripts/replicate_objects.py --once, while the current script did not accept that frozen spelling and exited 2. The adapter preserves its existing one-pass behavior and adds --once without starting a loop or changing the systemd no-flag invocation.

The previous OCI queue query checked only a verified R2 status. A stale or different verified R2 cipher could therefore have permitted an OCI upload of a different current ciphertext. OCI now requires matching R2 original SHA, cipher SHA, and algorithm before any remote call.
The previous recipient guard ran after local directory/SQLite initialization. It now runs first, so a stripped-environment frozen command fails without creating runtime state.
residual_risk_and_non_claims: No real R2, OCI, GitHub, Cloudflare, account, credential, provider request, age binary invocation, ciphertext upload, remote readback/delete, data upload, Docker action, deployment, Git stage/commit/push/merge/rebase, new worktree, legacy ignored-runtime access, or destructive cleanup occurred. Unit fixtures use temporary fake encryptor/S3 clients only.

The isolated commands deliberately remove all provider environment values and report BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT. They prove frozen CLI compatibility and fail-closed behavior, not OCI/R2 account access, bucket privacy, free-tier availability, real cipher persistence, or remote readback.

The real Owner-authorized OCI encrypted canary remains NOT_RUN. Its prerequisite is explicit owner-approved recipient plus OCI and already-verified R2 configuration; it must remain separate from fixture PASS and must never expose plaintext or a private identity.

GitHub encrypted third replica, Private-Database completion synchronization, operations recovery, and final release gates remain unfinished in SA-503 through SA-507. No intermediate Git publication is authorized before the full Task Pack passes.
